problem_type: Premature first-time telemetry consent prompt before creator value milestone
symptom: Creating a first blank project immediately shows the large first-time telemetry consent card in the center of the empty Agent panel before the creator has written, generated, or completed a conversation.
direct_cause: V4ConsentCard initialized mode to 'first' solely from !hasAskedAgentConsent(), without requiring a completed generation or first Agent conversation milestone.
class_root: First-time consent eligibility lived as a bare negative check in the UI component instead of a shared readiness predicate owned by onboardingState that binds asking to a real creator milestone.
affected_population: New creators opening their first blank project with a text model configured
entry_points: AgentPanelV4Consent via AgentPanelV4Empty on empty Agent panel
useOnboardingProgress observing first successful canvas node ('generated') and settled Agent conversation turns / historical lanes
internal_only_reason: Telemetry first-ask gating and onboarding milestone persistence are internal application invariants owned by onboardingState and V4ConsentCard.
invariants: V4ConsentCard in production mode ('first') never renders while !canAskFirstAgentConsent(), i.e. before either first generation or first completed Agent turn (or historical multi-thread usage).
Once a milestone is reached and consent has not been asked yet, V4ConsentCard reveals 'first' mode live or on next empty-state mount and asks at most once across restarts.
Legacy scope reconfirmation (mode='scope') and design-lab force overrides remain intact.

door_reduction.why_not: All onboarding cross-session flags share onboardingState.ts as their single storage module; the additional symbol references reflect centralized readiness predicate canAskFirstAgentConsent, live sync event ONBOARDING_STATE_SYNC_EVENT, and first-turn completion writer in onboardingProgress without creating a parallel state store.

generality_proof: Every production render of V4ConsentCard evaluates the single centralized predicate canAskFirstAgentConsent() from onboardingState.ts and listens to ONBOARDING_STATE_SYNC_EVENT / storage changes, so no surface (creation, storyboard, generation, preview) can show first-time consent prior to a real milestone.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the single cross-session eligibility predicate combining asked state, first generation milestone, and first completed Agent turn milestone, plus live sync notification.
Enforce canAskFirstAgentConsent() for mode='first', react to live milestone updates, preserve force overrides for design lab, and keep legacy mode='scope' intact.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Mounts V4ConsentCard without force across creation, storyboard, generation, and preview empty states, so all surfaces inherit the deferred readiness gate.
Design lab explicitly passes force='first' or force='scope' to inspect static card variants.
Settings toggle is user-initiated opt-in/out and legacy scope confirmation, never a first-screen prompt.

recurrence.reason: Any empty Agent panel surface (creation, storyboard, generation, preview) or newly created blank project hit the same unguarded !hasAskedAgentConsent() check.
same_class_scan: git grep V4ConsentCard across src/ and tests/: only one production mount (AgentPanelV4Empty.tsx) and two design lab mounts using force.

git grep hasAskedAgentConsent / data-v4-block='consent' across src/ and tests/: audited AgentPanelV4Consent.tsx, feedback-loop-consent-and-report.walk.mjs, telemetry-consent-copy.walk.mjs, telemetry-scope-reconfirm.walk.mjs, and design-lab-agent-panel-v4.walk.mjs.

prevention.invariant: canAskFirstAgentConsent() returns true only when !hasAskedAgentConsent() and (readChecklist().generated || hasCompletedFirstAgentTurn() || hasHistoricalAgentThread).
prevention.failure_mode: When localStorage is unavailable or neither milestone is met, canAskFirstAgentConsent() fails closed to false and V4ConsentCard renders nothing.
prevention.strategy: Centralize first-ask eligibility and milestone sync events in onboardingState.ts and enforce them at V4ConsentCard, backed by unit tests and real-window walkthrough assertions.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replaced the bare !hasAskedAgentConsent() immediate prompt check in V4ConsentCard with canAskFirstAgentConsent() in the same commit without leaving a parallel fallback.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls telemetry consent timing or onboarding milestones.

migration: Existing users who already answered consent retain nomi:agent-consent-asked:v1='asked' and continue to see scope reconfirmation when applicable. New key nomi:first-agent-turn-completed:v1 is additive and safely ignored on rollback.
residual_risks: Creators who never generate media and never send an Agent message will not see the in-panel first-ask card; they can still toggle telemetry anytime in Settings.
